feed.title: Free small-business calculators — tools on marisstella.dev
feed.subtitle: The 1254 free, browser-only tools served directly from marisstella.dev — the newest 20 of them listed here, newest first. No account, no upload: every number stays on your own device. The full catalogue is larger and lives at tools.marisstella.dev.
feed.rights: Tools are MIT-licensed. They are estimates and records to act on, not professional advice.

entry.title: Cancel Flow — Free Self-Hosted Stripe Cancellation Flow
entry.summary: Keep subscribers who only needed a nudge. A cancellation flow for Stripe that asks why, offers a pause or a discount matched to the reason, and reports your save rate. Preview it in the browser, then run the open-source server in your own account. Free, MIT.

entry.title: Drip Keeper — Free Self-Hosted Lifecycle Email
entry.summary: A free, open-source alternative to Customer.io, Loops and Userlist: your app posts events, sequences send onboarding, trial and win-back email, and a goal event stops the rest. Preview exactly what a person would receive and when, in your browser, then run the server in your own account.

entry.title: Dunning Engine — Free Self-Hosted Stripe Failed Payment Recovery
entry.summary: Recover failed Stripe subscription payments with decline-code-aware retries and emails you control. Preview the recovery schedule for any decline code, then run the open-source server in your own account. Free, MIT, no per-recovery fee.

entry.title: Feedback Board — Free Self-Hosted Feature Requests, Roadmap and Changelog
entry.summary: Collect feature requests, let customers vote, catch duplicates as they type, publish a roadmap and a changelog with RSS. One small open-source server you run yourself. Free, MIT, no per-user fee. Try the duplicate finder in your browser.

entry.title: Flag Keeper — Free Self-Hosted Feature Flags
entry.summary: A free, open-source alternative to LaunchDarkly, Flagsmith and Unleash: percentage rollouts that stay sticky, targeting rules, segments, prerequisites and a kill switch in one small server. Simulate a rollout and see exactly who would flip before you ship it, in your browser.

entry.title: Form Inbox — Free Self-Hosted Form Backend With Spam Scoring
entry.summary: Point any HTML form at your own server: spam scoring with visible reasons, an inbox, CSV export and email or Slack notifications. Open source, MIT, no per-submission fee. Test the spam filter in your browser.

entry.title: World Traveler
entry.summary: A Garmin Connect IQ watch face with a fixed 24-hour ring and 42 world cities placed at their current local hour. No permissions, no network.

entry.title: Job Application Tracker — Free, Private, No Sign-Up
entry.summary: Free job application tracker that stays on your device: no account, nothing uploaded. Log applications, get follow-up reminders (calendar export), see which sources actually reply, and export to CSV any time.

entry.title: License Keeper — Free Self-Hosted License Keys for Stripe Sellers
entry.summary: Sell desktop apps, plugins and CLI tools with Stripe and issue signed license keys automatically. Generate a key pair, sign a test license and verify it right in your browser, then run the open-source server in your own account. Free, MIT, no per-license fee.

entry.title: Link Keeper — Free Self-Hosted Link Shortener with Click Stats
entry.summary: A free, open-source alternative to Bitly, Dub and Rebrandly: your own short domain, UTM-tagged campaign links, iOS/Android app routing, expiry, click limits and privacy-friendly stats with no cookies and no stored IPs. Plan a batch of links in your browser first.

entry.title: Meter Keeper — Free Self-Hosted Usage Metering for Stripe
entry.summary: A free, open-source alternative to Lago, Orb and Metronome for small SaaS: send usage events to your own server, get exact per-customer usage, tiered invoice previews, hard-limit checks, and a reliable feed into Stripe Billing Meters. Try your pricing on real usage numbers in your browser first.

entry.title: MRR Pulse — Free Self-Hosted Stripe MRR & Churn Dashboard
entry.summary: See MRR, ARR, net revenue retention, logo churn and quick ratio from your Stripe subscriptions without paying a metrics service a share of your revenue. Paste a subscription export to try it in the browser, then run the open-source read-only server in your own account. Free, MIT.

entry.title: ShootFlow
entry.summary: ShootFlow is an early-stage open-source toolkit for safely ingesting photo and video media and planning graded reels, carousels and photo sets.

entry.title: Photos Import Tools
entry.summary: Resumable, manifest-backed command-line tools that import JPEG and RAW photos into Apple Photos and offload SD cards with hash verification.

entry.title: Referral Keeper — Free Self-Hosted Affiliate Program for Stripe
entry.summary: Run an affiliate or referral program on your own Stripe account: tracking link, recurring commissions, refund clawbacks, payout CSV. Plan what a program will cost you in your browser, then deploy the open-source server. Free, MIT, no revenue share.

entry.title: Retail Pilot Intel
entry.summary: Open-source, privacy-first retail analytics concept for small-format pilot stores: SKU gaps, experiments and ROI reporting, built as a TypeScript monorepo.

entry.title: Rev Rec — Free Stripe Deferred Revenue & Revenue Recognition Schedule
entry.summary: Turn Stripe invoices into a monthly revenue recognition schedule: billings, revenue recognised, deferred revenue and journal entries for your bookkeeper. Paste an invoice export to try it in the browser, then run the open-source read-only server in your own account. Free, MIT.

entry.title: RFP Compliance Matrix Generator: shall and must statements to a spreadsheet
entry.summary: Paste an RFP, RFQ or tender. Get a compliance matrix of every shall/must/required obligation with section numbers, categories and owner/status columns, plus the page limits, due dates and forms. CSV download. Private, in your browser.

entry.title: Security Questionnaire Answer Matcher: reuse your past answers
entry.summary: Paste a customer security questionnaire and your saved answers. Each question is matched to your closest past answer, risky matches (changed hours, negations) are flagged, and unanswered questions are listed. Private, in your browser, free.

entry.title: status-keeper — Free Self-Hosted Status Page and Uptime Monitor
entry.summary: A free, self-hosted status page with uptime monitoring, 90-day bars, incidents, maintenance windows and alerts. An open-source alternative to Statuspage, Instatus and Better Stack. MIT, zero dependencies.
